dependency_coverage.meaning: Pointwise addition of two real vectors indexed by Fin n: (x + y)(i) = x(i) + y(i).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: The nonnegative coordinatewise absolute-product pairing P(x,y) = sum over i in Fin s of |x(i)| |y(i)|.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard finite dot product x dot y = sum over i in Fin s of x(i)y(i).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the six dot-product equalities with values 1, 1/2, and 0.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: Entrywise addition of two real square matrices indexed by Fin s: (A + B)(i,j) = A(i,j) + B(i,j).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: Matrix-vector multiplication: (Ax)(i) = sum over j in Fin s of A(i,j)x(j).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real 2 by 2 matrix A_6 = [[0,0],[1/2,0]], with rows and columns ordered by Fin 2 indices 0 and 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is one summand of A_8 and satisfies A_6 x_15 = x_12.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real 2 by 2 matrix A_7 = [[1/2,0],[0,0]], with rows and columns ordered by Fin 2 indices 0 and 1.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: The zero vector x_10 = (0,0) in R^2.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real vector x_11 = (0,1).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014

mathematical_definitions: All indices range over Fin 2, identified in constructor order with coordinates 0 and 1.
Matrix addition is entrywise, vector addition is coordinatewise, and (Ax)(i) = sum over j = 0,1 of A(i,j)x(j).
The dot product is x dot y = x(0)y(0) + x(1)y(1).
The constants 0, 1, and 1/2 are exact real numbers.
translation.proposition_plain_english: This closed proposition asserts all of the following simultaneously for the explicitly fixed real 2 by 2 matrices and two-coordinate real vectors: A_8 is the entrywise sum of A_6 and A_7; x_14 is x_12 + x_13; x_11 is x_9 + x_10; multiplying x_15 by A_6 and A_7 gives x_12 and x_13 respectively; the dot products x_11 dot x_15 and x_11 dot x_14 are exactly 1 and 1/2; the four listed dot products involving x_10 or the pair (x_11,x_13) are zero; and the coordinatewise absolute-product pairings P(x_10,x_15) and P(x_11,x_13) are also zero.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The proposition is closed and restricted to one explicitly specified collection of real 2 by 2 matrices and vectors in R^2; it contains no universal or existential quantifiers.
There are no hypotheses and no implication, so there is no vacuity risk from an inconsistent or false assumption.
Every equality involving x_10 in a scalar pairing is automatic because x_10 is the zero vector.
The zero dot and absolute-product values for x_11 and x_13 follow from their disjoint nonzero coordinate supports.
P(x,y) is the sum of coordinatewise absolute products, not by itself a stated norm of either vector.
All arithmetic is exact real arithmetic; the proposition encodes no approximation, floating-point computation, error bound, inequality, conditioning statement, or general stability property.
